title: The Awakening
mission: Locate the hidden flag (.hidden_flag) concealed in your home directory.
hint: Files starting with a '.' are hidden by default. Check 'man ls' to see how to list all files.

title: The Reading Room
mission: Navigate through nested directories under 'archives' and read the secret document. Note: filenames may contain spaces!
hint: Use 'cd' to change directories. Wrap filenames with spaces in quotes (e.g., cat 'top secret document.txt') or escape spaces with a backslash.
